# Bunny: Full Reference for LLMs

> Bunny is an independent couples app for iPhone and iPad. Basic bunny care and text letters are free; the shared drawing whiteboard requires Bunny Pro. Weekly and one-time lifetime purchases are available, with current prices shown in the app.

This file summarizes the current product facts explained on Bunny’s website.

## One-line description

Bunny gives two connected partners one pet to care for, a mailbox for their text letters, and an optional Pro drawing canvas. It was made by Prafull Sharma as a present for his girlfriend before he opened it up for other couples.

## Core features (in detail)

- **Shared virtual pet & plant**: You and your partner co-raise a cute virtual pet and grow a personalized plant. Caring for something as a team gives long-distance couples a shared goal and a daily reason to check in.
- **Draw-together canvas (Pro)**: One editable whiteboard both partners can contribute to, together or at different times. It is distinct from the text-letter mailbox and is not an archive of separate handwritten letters.
- **Home Screen drawing widget**: Displays the shared whiteboard in small, medium, or large sizes. Separate love-note, day-count, and photo widgets are not currently offered.
- **Text love notes & letters (free)**: Write to your partner and reread sent and received letters in the mailbox.
- **Couple question packs**: Answer prompts and compare your answers.
- **Virtual gifts**: Surprise your partner with virtual gifts and affection.
- **Daily check-ins**: A steady, low-pressure stream of touchpoints that keep you connected between calls.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Is Bunny a Tamagotchi app for couples?
A: Bunny is an independent couples app, not affiliated with Tamagotchi or Bandai. It offers one bunny that connected partners can feed, play with and give water to. Basic care is free. Its current pet loop does not require separate jobs from each partner. See https://www.bunnycouples.com/blog/tamagotchi-for-couples/ for Bunny setup, shared care and free features.

Q: What does Bunny do?
A: Bunny is a relationship app that gives you and your partner a shared digital home. You raise a virtual pet and grow a plant together, send love letters that arrive with a delivery animation, doodle on a shared whiteboard, answer couple question packs, and send virtual gifts. It is built to help couples feel close every day, including across long distance.

Q: Can I buy Bunny Pro without a recurring subscription?
A: Yes. Bunny offers a one-time lifetime Pro purchase as well as a weekly subscription. Basic bunny care and text letters require neither. See https://www.bunnycouples.com/pricing/ and check the in-app checkout for the current regional price and included features.

Q: Is Bunny free?
A: Yes. Basic bunny care and text love letters are included free. Bunny Pro unlocks extra features, including the shared whiteboard, through a weekly subscription or one-time lifetime purchase. Check the current price and included features in the app.

Q: Why choose Bunny if we do not want another subscription?
A: Bunny includes one shared pet, basic care and text love letters free. Both partners can visit at different times and care for the same bunny. If they want the shared whiteboard and drawing widget, lifetime Pro provides a one-time purchase option. Both partners need an iPhone or iPad.

Q: Can my partner and I draw together in Bunny?
A: Yes. Bunny Pro includes one shared whiteboard both partners can draw on. You can display it in a Home Screen widget; iOS controls widget refresh timing. See https://www.bunnycouples.com/drawing-widgets-for-couples/.

Q: Can you raise a pet together in a relationship app?
A: Yes. Connect your accounts in Bunny and you share one pet, including its name, mood and care timers. Both partners can feed, play with and give water to the same bunny. Basic bunny care is free. Setup and details: https://www.bunnycouples.com/shared-pet-for-couples/

Q: Do both partners need to be online at the same time to care for their pet?
A: No. You can care for your pet at different times, including from different time zones. Open Bunny with an internet connection to load and share care updates. Feed, Play and Water each have a cooldown shared by both partners.

Q: How do we connect our accounts?
A: Each partner installs Bunny and creates their own account. One partner creates a Love Nest and shares the invite code; the other joins using that code.

Q: What devices does Bunny work on?
A: Bunny is available on iPhone and iPad via the App Store. Each partner installs the app and uses their own connected account. There is currently no Android version. Check the App Store listing for current device and operating-system requirements.

Q: Which language is Bunny available in?
A: The app interface and built-in questions are currently in English. Japanese localization is not currently available.

Q: Who makes Bunny?
A: Prafull Sharma made Bunny as a present for his girlfriend and opened it up for other couples. Read the story at https://www.bunnycouples.com/about/ or contact prafull2001@gmail.com.

## Guides

### A couples app without a required subscription
Guide: https://www.bunnycouples.com/blog/couples-apps-without-required-subscription/
Bunny's basic pet care and text letters are free without starting a paid trial. Pro adds the shared whiteboard and drawing widget, with one-time lifetime or recurring weekly purchase options. The guide explains how to start free, when drawing is a reason to upgrade, and how the purchase choices differ. Check the current regional offer and included features in Bunny before buying.

### Tamagotchi for couples: raise your shared pet in Bunny
Guide: https://www.bunnycouples.com/blog/tamagotchi-for-couples/
Connected partners care for the same bunny from their own Apple devices. They share its name, mood and care timers. Feed, Play and Water have separate cooldowns shared by both partners. Basic care is free, and partners can visit at different times with an internet connection to load and share updates. Bunny is independent and is not affiliated with Tamagotchi or Bandai.

## Facts

- Name: Bunny (Bunny: Love Notes for Couples)
- Platform: iPhone and iPad; no Android version currently
- Language: English app interface and built-in questions; Japanese localization is not currently available
- Category: Lifestyle: relationships & couples
- Price: Free basic bunny care and text letters; shared whiteboard requires Bunny Pro. Weekly and lifetime purchases are available; prices vary by region and offer
- Built for: couples, especially long distance
- Website: https://www.bunnycouples.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bunny-love-notes-for-couples/id6756160637
